title: Mixed Event — Unfading Wishing

meta.Outline: The US trip is coming up fast, and Akito's been practicing at full throttle. He takes a well-earned break on New Year's Day, but while he's out and about, he ends up running into a certain someone...

rows.Line: New Year's Eve
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, here's to another great year in the books!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheers.
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's not much, but we prepared a few dishes.
Please feel free to have as much as you all like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Roast beef, gratin, sushi rolls and omelets... “Not much”, you say, but this is a pretty decadent spread.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We decided to roll up our sleeves after we heard that you'd all be throwing your party here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We also helped!
For example, we plated this salad!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We've even prepared some ice cream for dessert. You have your choice of rum raisin and mocha!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! Definitely rum raisin for me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'll try the mocha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, I could really go for some of that rum raisin right now! Can I start with that...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, hold your horses...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm guessing we're all hungry, since we just finished practicing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You had practice on New Year's Eve? I guess we shouldn't have expected otherwise, but you all seem really motivated!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Motivated, huh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I guess we are...
I mean, we can't waste any time just standing around.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I like the expressions on your faces, but do be careful not to push yourselves too hard. Make sure to take breaks when you can, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're doing just that!
Right, Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we don't have practice tomorrow, so An and I are going to go see the New Year's show at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They're doing a New Year's show?!
That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. This time, only during New Year's, Kagami Mochi Phenny is going to appear! I can't wait to see him!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. That seems like a nice way to spend New Year's.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, while we're on the subject, how are you guys all gonna spend New Year's?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. We're glad that you asked!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're gonna play Hanetsuki! Right, Rin?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We're gonna get revenge on Miku and MEIKO after losing to them last time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, KAITO, we're not letting you guys beat us either!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. Challenge accepted!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're not about to back down either.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honestly, you guys are like the only people I know who take Hanetsuki this seriously.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, Hanetsuki has been receiving quite a lot of attention in recent years...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As a competitive sport no less.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wow... I just did a quick search, and it looks way more intense than I initially thought.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It feels a lot like competitive badminton.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The way these paddles are designed may have something to do with that. It seems easier to keep rallies going, which would certainly increase the stakes of each game.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, and they look really cool!
I wanna try using one!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. Then, after we're done with our shrine visit, why don't we go visit a sporting goods store together?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, you mean it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Akito and I are both scheduled to be right near the mall tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it shouldn't take that long to go through all their Hanetsuki stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys are going to the mall?
Any plans to check out the New Year's sales?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, we're actually going to a cafe.
Akito's hoping to have some of their New Year's pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, Toya, they don't need to know that part.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha!
You're going to have pancakes on New Year's, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But those pancakes are going to allow us to play competitive Hanetsuki.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, Akito, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to play against you guys!
A few hours later
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yawn...
Still sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I couldn't stay awake. I might've gone a little overboard during practice earlier this morning...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hm? This smell...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito, are you awake?
I just made some New Year's soba.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I was wondering what that brothy smell was. It was this soba.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: It's just about ready, so would you mind getting Ena? She should be in her room.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, one second.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This still doesn't seem right...
I might be drawing the shadows wrong...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Ena, Mom made some soba and told me to come get you.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line:
I'm guessing you're still drawing...
I'm coming in, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Mom made some New Year's soba...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh?!
What's wrong with you, Akito?! Who said you could come in?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's your fault for not hearing me knock.
I'm here to tell you that Mom made some New Year's soba for us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Soba...? Wait, it's already that late?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, I've done my job.
I'm gonna go have my soba before it gets soggy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, fine. But I was just starting to find my groove...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh...
Actually, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're going over to the United States soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You guys are gonna try to take over the world or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Does that mean you'll be going overseas a lot in the future?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, there's a good chance of that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we're only going over to see an event during this trip.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What is it...?
If you have something to say, then say it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, nevermind...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I've lost my concentration, so I think I'll take a break and have some soba.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A break? You still plan on drawing afterwards...? Aren't you going to hang out with Momoi tomorrow? You're gonna oversleep if you stay up too late.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm almost done, so I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Plus, I'm really looking forward to hanging out with Airi tomorrow since it's been so long since we last did. There's no way I'm gonna oversleep.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The words of a person who uses her own brother as an alarm clock don't really hold much weight.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shut up!
Anyway, step aside! I don't want my soba to get soggy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you were the one who...

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line:
Mom!
Do we still have some of that soba spice mix?
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
I'm glad that our final stream of the year went as well as it did.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “New Year's Eve With MORE MORE JUMP!” was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd love to make my own soba noodles again! Especially since they ended up being so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still, we got a lot of viewers this time around.
I have to think that your commercial did the trick again for us, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That certainly would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's keep up the momentum starting tomorrow when the new year begins.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You all sound very excited about the upcoming year.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Things might be a little hard right now, but I'm sure you girls will find a way to overcome this obstacle.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's switch gears and start preparing for our next stream!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even though we have New Year's Day off, we'll be streaming on the second. So, we'll need to get everything in order for that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, about that...
I thought we could do some extra segments. What do you guys think?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That sounds wonderful!
After all, we want everyone to have as much fun as possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But what kinds of extra segments should we do?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're only just now planning them, so we probably won't be able to do anything too involved...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, what do you already have planned for your stream on the second?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... We're going to draw our fortunes using the omikuji boxes we made, and make the New Year's dishes our fans request and have a little feast together. It should be pretty festive.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow!
That sounds like such a fun New Year's stream!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It is important to do seasonal stuff for these kinds of streams.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, does that mean your extra segments should also have a New Year's feel to them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A New Year's feel...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, what if you did another stream about New Year's games?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Another stream about New Year's games?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, because we heard that the one you did last year went very well. You may have some new fans watching, so it could be good to do another one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It did go pretty well last time...
But we sort of landed on trying not to do anything too similar to what we've already done.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right.
But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see nothing wrong with that idea!
It should be fun for everyone, as long as we change up which games we play.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, good point.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, it's settled!
Your extra segments will be another round of New Year's games!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, let's start deciding which games we're going to play, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We have a long list of options.
But the ones that would make our New Year's stream fun for everyone would be...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... We played Karuta and Fukuwarai last time... So, for this stream, what if we made mochi together? We could take turns using the pestle!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not sure many people would count making mochi as a New Year's game...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, even if we started looking now, I doubt we'd be able to find a proper mortar and pestle in time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right... I thought it was a good idea, since we didn't get a chance to last time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, actually... What if we played a true-to-life version of Fukuwarai?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A true-to-life version?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! People on social media have been talking about how you can take pictures of each other and make cutouts using them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. And it would be a fresh take on something we've already done, so we could have a lot of fun with it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I'll put true-to-life Fukuwarai on the list. What else can we play...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Fukuwarai is definitely a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But nothing else seems to fit the bill.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well...
Playing with spinning tops and kites would be fun, but they're missing that extra something...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
At least one more game would be nice.
Ideally, something that involves us competing against each other, since everyone watching could try to guess who's going to win...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But we also don't have a lot of time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try finding something tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Find? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As it so happens, I'm gonna go check out the New Year's sales with Ena tomorrow. I'll try seeing if the toy stores and stuff have anything we can use.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right...
A toy store could provide you with some new insights...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, Airi, would it be possible for me to join you tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Seeing what each store carries may help me come up with a good idea.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I'd like to do what I can to help you all shine as brightly as possible when you do play these games!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, you're absolutely welcome to join us!
But I won't be able to talk to you much, since I'm gonna be there with my friend. If you're okay with that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'll take quick peeks while staying hidden in your pocket!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Then, I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make our New Year's stream a good one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
New Year's Day
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Phew...
That shrine was totally packed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I suppose that was to be expected, since it's such a famous shrine.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm glad that we were both able to draw great blessings. It's an excellent way to start off the new year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, true.
We're gonna need all the luck we can get.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Still, this place is also packed with people...
There might be a huge line to get into that cafe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We may want to head there early, since you mentioned that they'd be serving only a few plates of those New Year's pancakes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should probably head to the cafe before visiting the sporting goods store at the mall.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sound weirdly excited about this for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you're right about not wasting time waiting in line. Let's head over there now.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I've been meaning to ask...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Could you tell me more about these New Year's pancakes? I've been having a hard time figuring out how they managed to tie a Western dish to this holiday...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, they gave it a Japanese twist by making it look like kagami mochi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Apparently, it's a stack of three pancakes coated in white chocolate and a mandarin on top.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
White chocolate...?!
That's quite bold of them...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It is pretty strange, but a lot of people who had it last year gave good reviews.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, there. It's that cafe...
se_walk_men_001_2
se_walk_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yikes, there's a huge line...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had a feeling, but this place must be just that popular.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That being said, I don't mind waiting.
We're not doing anything else other than visiting that sporting goods store, so let's get in line.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel kinda bad, but I agree. Let's find the end of this line...
Huh? Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's my line.
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, Ena, call off your dogs. It's New Year's, remember?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Akito, Toya!
I'm surprised to see you two here!
Grabbing a bite?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Momoi.
One of their menu items caught our attention, so we came to try it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
One of their menu items...?
Are you two here to try their New Year's pancakes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, don't tell me you're also here for them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's right... More importantly, what's with the attitude? You got here after us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When we got here doesn't matter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Again, you two!
Quit bickering!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look, us running into each other like this can't just be a coincidence, so let's all wait together, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I asked Ena this a second ago, but how do you two plan on spending New Year's?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
New Year's?
Well, we're going to practice singing like usual...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
With the exception of tomorrow.
We're actually going to play competitive Hanetsuki with some friends.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Competitive Hanetsuki?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's Hanetsuki with rules that mirror similar sports. As you can probably see from this image, they use larger paddles and shuttlecocks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Cool...! That's really cute, and this looks really fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
We could play this during our stream...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! We're planning on playing a few New Year's games during our stream tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we had trouble coming up with ones that would be entertaining on a stream. Ena and I are actually gonna head over to the mall to see if they have anything good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we all go together?
We were also planning to head over to the mall after checking out this cafe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? If you two are okay with it, then I'd love to have you guys there with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Does that sound okay, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not in love with the idea of going with Akito, but I guess it would make sense for us to go together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I heard that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Ena. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And I really need to thank you two!
You guys are lifesavers!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I tried searching for New Year's games we could play during our stream, but I ended up with way too many choices. It was hard to pick just one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean.
You can fly kites, play Kendama...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My sisters and I used to play Karuta a lot when we were little. I also remember crying a lot since I could never beat my big sis.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
New Year's, huh...?
We usually played that one board game about life.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I remember a certain someone always placing a big bet that invariably put them deep in debt.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, are you talking about me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I mean, you never did anything interesting.
You always ended up leading a boring life with no detours.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Stable is the word I'd use.
Which is better than being underwater in my opinion.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Playing games with your family certainly sounds quite fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My family never really did any of those things, so this is all a bit new to me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Was everyone usually busy?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, my dad usually performed in New Year's concerts overseas. We'd go as a family to watch him play.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Concerts?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your family really is all about music, huh?

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you for your patience. I can show you three to your table now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, we've been talking for so long that we're pretty close to the front now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Time sure does fly when you're having an enjoyable conversation.

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Are you our next group? I'm terribly sorry, but do you have a moment...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you referring to us?

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Yes, I regret to inform you all that...
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting the place to be so crowded that we'd be asked to share a table.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... Why do I have to start off the new year by eating pancakes with you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you don't wanna stay, then you're free to leave. I'll have the ones you ordered.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What? I am not leaving.
I've also been looking forward to having them.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
I have three plates of our limited pancakes, and the toasted sandwich drink set.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you. I ordered the sandwich set.
The pancakes are for these three.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, these look amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Talk about photogenic! They clearly put a lot of effort into these toppings, and they're so colorful!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's apparently white bean paste inside the pancakes. I'm really looking forward to this!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... So this is how they're making these pancakes look like kagami mochi...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. First, I'm gonna take some pics...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're taking more pictures...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway...
I'm gonna have these while they're still hot.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (These are good...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I thought it'd be a lot sweeter since they covered this whole thing in white chocolate, but the fruit's acidity is doing a good job of balancing it out.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I definitely wouldn't mind getting more.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seem to like them very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm?
Yeah, I do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You get the pictures you wanted, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Check it out. Don't they look amazing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, they do!
These look better on your screen than they do in real life!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know you're good at taking selfies, but you've become such a great photographer. I might have you take pictures of me sometime.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No problem! I feel like I know how to make you look the cutest, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll be looking forward to our shoot!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Those two really are close.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But it still feels kinda weird that Ena has such a good friend.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (As far as I know, Momoi's had Ena's best interests at heart ever since they first met.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Not only do they hang out like this, she's always been there to listen and cheer Ena up.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Including that time...)
A few years earlier
